text: Paid features which are not disclosed upon entering app.
author: Rizz
developer_reply: Hey Rizz, sorry for the confusion! Levla is free to play and most of our players never pay a cent. Some content is members-only and marked with a lock, and the free trial is 7 days with no charge unless you choose to continue. Happy to help if something charged you unexpectedly, hit me on Discord. - Mod Ed
